posts.text: No. I think you’re thinking of another Goldberg. Happens all the time.

“Good morning. It’s Tuesday. It’s so strange being a city dog. This morning there was a police car with a very large and scary dog inside. Or at least it sounded like that. We couldn’t see thru the windows. Maybe the car was barking and shaking on its own? Anyway, Zoë seemed very proud that she had control of the street while the other dog was trapped inside. I was a little scared. We never saw the doggy or the police person. I’ve always been told that the police are my friend. Now I’m not sure.

“Good morning. It’s Monday. I like trying to go into other peoples houses and cars when I’m in a new neighborhood. It makes my people angry. But all the other people I say hi to don’t seem to mind. Also, I love you.”
“Good morning. It’s Friday. Don’t be frightened by my collar. It’s for scaring away mean dogs. At least that’s what they told me. Also, I love you.”
I forgot I’ve had an account here since 2023. Kicking the tires now.
Giving this a whirl. This is my first Bluesky post and, yes, I'm tweeting pictures of my dogs. Don't say you weren't warned.
